prompt.en: What must Cabinet ministers do if they are defeated in a non-confidence vote?
prompt.fr: Que doivent faire les ministres s'ils sont défaits lors d'un vote de non-confiance?

options.en: Nothing; the government keeps its full four-year term.
options.fr: Rien; le gouvernement termine son mandat de quatre ans.

options.en: Ask the Senate to hold the vote again.
options.fr: Demander au Sénat de reprendre le vote.

options.en: Wait for a court to decide.

explanation.en: Ministers answer to the elected members. They govern only as long as they keep the confidence of the House, so a government here does not sit out a fixed term the way a president does.
explanation.fr: Les ministres sont responsables devant les élus. Ils ne gouvernent que tant qu'ils conservent la confiance de la Chambre : un gouvernement ne termine donc pas automatiquement un mandat fixe, comme le ferait un président.

source.quote: Cabinet ministers are responsible to the elected representatives, which means they must retain the “confidence of the House” and have to resign if they are defeated in a non- confidence vote.
